tools.description: What depends on a system, up to a number of hops upstream, and who owns each dependent.

system.description: Name of the system, e.g. billing-api. Resolved against the graph (System); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

tools.name: why
tools.description: Why the memory believes or refused a fact: the gate receipts for it and what the memory holds now. The subject may be an entity or a record id (a ticket whose data was refused).

subject.description: Who or what the fact is about, or a record id such as TCK-0044. Resolved against the graph (System/Person/Team/Decision/Project/Agent/Episode); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

predicate.description: Relationship, e.g. OWNS. Personal-data predicates show refusals.

object.description: The other end of the fact. Resolved against the graph (System/Person/Team/Decision/Project/Agent); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

b.description: Second entity. Resolved against the graph (System/Person/Team/Decision/Project/Agent); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

tools.name: facts_about

entity.description: The entity to describe. Resolved against the graph (System/Person/Team/Decision/Project/Agent); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

person.description: Full name of the person, e.g. Oskar Alvarez. Resolved against the graph (Person); an unknown name returns unknown_entity.

episode|ADR-0014.author: Oskar Alvarez
episode|ADR-0014.title: ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys
episode|ADR-0014.text:
ADR-0014: Encrypt ledger-db backups with rotating keys
Author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-08-24. Status: accepted on 2026-09-02.
Constrains: ledger-db.
Context: A backup copy of ledger-db could be read by anyone with access to the storage bucket.
Decision: Every ledger-db backup is encrypted with a key that rotates every 90 days; a restore needs the current key from the security on-call.
Consequences: Restores take a few minutes longer. Losing the key history makes old backups unreadable.

episode|ADR-0015.author: Oskar Alvarez
episode|ADR-0015.title: ADR-0015: Mask customer names in reporting exports
episode|ADR-0015.text:
ADR-0015: Mask customer names in reporting exports
Author: Oskar Alvarez
Draft opened: 2026-09-07. Status: accepted on 2026-09-16.
Constrains: reporting.
Context: CSV exports from reporting carried customer names to people who only needed totals.
Decision: reporting masks customer names in every CSV export unless the requester holds the export role.
Consequences: Analysts ask for the export role when they need names.

episode|DOC-14.author: Oskar Alvarez
episode|DOC-14.title: Integration: fernhill-sso
episode|DOC-14.text:
Integration: fernhill-sso (single sign-on for the customer Fernhill Outfitters).
Owner: Oskar Alvarez (Platform).
Kind: customer integration.
fernhill-sso depends on auth.
Fernhill Outfitters signs in through their own identity provider; fernhill-sso maps their users to Quillfield Billing accounts.
The certificate rollover steps for this integration are written down here and nowhere else.

episode|DOC-17.author: Oskar Alvarez
episode|DOC-17.title: Handoff notes: Oskar Alvarez
episode|DOC-17.text:
Handoff notes: Oskar Alvarez.
Answers to the handoff questions, written before the last day (2026-10-09).
- ADR-0014 constrains ledger-db: the backup key rotates every 90 days and lives with the security on-call; restoring an older backup needs the key that was current when it was taken.
- ADR-0015 constrains reporting: masking runs in the CSV export step, and the Growth lead grants the export role.
- fernhill-sso depends on auth: the SAML certificate for the customer rolls over once a year, two weeks before it expires, following the steps in DOC-14.
Not covered here: oncall-runbook.

episode|DOC-18.author: Viktor Hartwell
episode|DOC-18.title: Handoff review: Viktor Hartwell
episode|DOC-18.text:
Handoff review: Viktor Hartwell.
I went through the handoff notes (DOC-17) with Oskar Alvarez and take over these decisions.
- ADR-0014 constrains ledger-db: confirmed; I hold the key rotation schedule from now on.
- ADR-0015 constrains reporting: confirmed; I review export role requests from now on.
